_readme: Prices for the system configurator. Edit this file only - no HTML or JS changes needed.
The numbers below are PLACEHOLDERS. Replace them with real prices, then set
"enabled": true to show prices on the site. While enabled is false the site shows
no prices at all, but the quote list and the request form still work.
'bases' is the price of the empty chassis for each size. 'modules' is the price per
module, counted once per module regardless of how many slots it occupies.
Keys in 'modules' must match the module names used by the configurator exactly.
_status: PLACEHOLDER PRICES - replace before setting enabled to true
